question: Which of the following are NOT contents of soil?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Steroids** are not naturally found in soil.
 
• Soil typically contains a variety of components such as **bacteria and fungi**, **grains of stones**, and **minerals**.
 
• These components contribute to the soil's fertility and structure, supporting plant growth and various ecological processes.
 
• The presence of microorganisms like **bacteria and fungi** is crucial for the decomposition of organic matter and nutrient cycling in the soil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Soil is a complex mixture of **minerals, organic matter, gases, liquids, and countless organisms** that together support life on Earth.
 
• The mineral portion of soil is derived from the weathering of rocks and is composed of sand, silt, and clay.
 
• Organic matter in soil includes plant and animal residues at various stages of decomposition, cells and tissues of soil organisms, and substances synthesized by the soil population.
 
• Soil health is vital for agricultural productivity, environmental sustainability, and the overall health of ecosystems.
